result: The stable and center-stable manifold theorems: the points whose orbits converge to a fixed point with an expanding direction lie on a lower-dimensional manifold tangent to the contracting directions, a set of measure zero. Applied to the gradient-descent map, this is why GD from a random start almost never converges to a strict saddle.
result_plain: Stable-manifold theorems: starts converging to a fixed point with an expanding direction form a measure-zero manifold, the basis of GD saddle avoidance.
